{{Top|leg}}
The '''DLR series protocol droid''' was a model of [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that served aboard the [[Cularin Trade Alliance]] vessel [[TAV Prosperity|''Prosperity'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], working in the [[Prosperity Casino and Entertainment Center|''Prosperity'' Casino and Entertainment Center]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were immune to all attempts to cheat at [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] games and each of the gambling tables in the [[Casino/Legends|casino]] was manned by a DLR series droid.
